findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_evo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evo_member_list, evo_member_get · Private data: evo_member_list, evo_member_get, evo_prospect_write_create, evo_prospect_write_update, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: evo_member_list, evo_member_get, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evo_member_list, evo_member_get · Private data: evo_member_list, evo_member_get, evo_prospect_write_create, evo_prospect_write_update, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: evo_member_list, evo_member_get, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
